svg.aria-label: pipekit-array on the GeoStack role ladder: ApplyAlong and BatchAlong as recipes, the operator twins, KernelOp, Einx and Estimator as steps, no algorithms or models of its own, kernel specs, policies and option sets as strategies, the named and plain-array functions as primitives, and DimArray, its adapters and layouts as structures; the test kit and the registration functions sit beside the ladder.
